title: Renew consent tokens without a manual command
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Expiring egress consent prompts once near expiry and renews on a yes; no 'susi privacy --egress' ritual. Tests zc_consent_renewal_*.
